name: stencils-remote
description: Design in Stencils with your agent, through Stencils' servers, from any computer.

interface.longDescription: Stencils is a design tool whose canvas is real HTML and CSS, so your agent can read a design as it's built and write to it as you watch. This plugin connects to Stencils' servers at https://mcp.stencils.app, so it works on any computer and in the cloud, with no app to install. The first time, your agent opens your browser to sign in with your Stencils account. On a Mac with Stencils installed, the stencils plugin is faster.
defaultPrompt: Describe the design on the current page
Design a pricing page with three plans
Make the buttons on this page consistent
